description: A script for executing and managing tasks within the Notesnook project, including dependency resolution, checksum calculation, and task execution with caching.

methods.name: readPkg
methods.description: Reads and caches the package.json content of a given package path.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from a given path.

methods.name: getPkgName
methods.description: Retrieves the package name from package.json or folder name.

methods.name: isPkg
methods.description: Checks if a path corresponds to a package with a specific name.

methods.name: findPkgs
methods.description: Finds all package directories matching the project configuration.

methods.name: filterDeps
methods.description: Filters dependencies that are local files within @notesnook scope.

methods.name: findDeps
methods.description: Recursively finds all dependencies for a package.

methods.name: resolvePkg
methods.description: Resolves a package's script commands and dependencies for a specific task.

methods.name: runScript
methods.description: Executes an npm script in a given package directory, with timing and error handling.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a filesystem path by resolving and removing trailing slash.

methods.name: toBatches
methods.description: Creates execution batches based on package dependencies to avoid cyclic issues.

methods.name: resolveRecursive
methods.description: Recursively resolves all dependencies for a package and task.

methods.name: computeChecksumFast
methods.description: Calculates a fast checksum of a directory based on file paths and metadata.

methods.name: computeChecksumSlow
methods.description: Calculates a slow checksum of a directory based on file contents.

methods.name: findKeyInObject
methods.description: Recursively searches for a key in an object.

methods.name: getBuildFolder
methods.description: Determines the build output folder for a package based on package.json fields.
